## Unblinding

Compound: **floxuridine** (PubChem CID [5790](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/5790))

Identity check: name and BBBC021 structure agree

ChEMBL mechanisms: Thymidylate synthase inhibitor

## Verdict (computed by code)

Correct: agent said **DNA replication**, BBBC021 annotates **DNA replication**.

## Reflection

The DNA replication call was correct because the large-cell large-nucleus signal replicated strongly: 1 uM showed cell_area z=+23.5 and frac_large_nucleus z=+14.6 in e6 and frac_large_nucleus z=+30.6 with nuc_area z=+14.5 on rep 2 in e13, with preserved low-dose onset at 0.3 uM in e14. Low multinucleation in e14 (frac_multinucleate_proxy z=-4.5) plus intact cytoskeleton was correctly used to down-weight Aurora kinase inhibitors despite the atlas split.

I was misled initially by the visual call in e4 suggesting Aurora kinase inhibitors and by compare_to_reference_atlas in e8 returning Aurora 5/10 versus DNA replication 3/10. The dose_response checks in e9-e11 were uninformative because they used only 4 saturated wells from 1-30 uM, giving negative Spearman rhos with p=0.2-0.8, which I correctly did not treat as contradicting a threshold-onset S-phase phenotype.

The acquisition choice to sample 3 uM and 30 uM first in e2-e3 revealed the saturated enlarged phenotype early but delayed finding the 0.3-1 uM threshold, which only e13-e14 resolved. Unblinding to floxuridine, a thymidylate synthase inhibitor per PMID 1532343 and PMID 3155521, fits the replicated cytomegaly also seen as megaloblastic change per PMID 6450011.

What was right:
- Prioritized replicated frac_large_nucleus and cell_area/nuc_area enlargement at 1-3 uM (e6, e13) as S-phase / DNA replication signature rather than mitotic failure.
- Used low multinucleation at 0.3 uM (e14) and intact cytoskeleton to reject Aurora and microtubule/actin hypotheses despite 5/10 Aurora atlas hits in e8.
- Did not over-interpret flat dose_response rhos in e9-e11 from saturated high doses, instead acquiring 1 uM rep 2 and 0.3 uM threshold wells.

What was wrong or missed:
- Gave initial weight to microscopist Aurora suggestion in e4 from only 2 fields at 3 uM before seeing the replicate and low-dose data.
- Relied on compare_to_reference_atlas e8 which favored Aurora 5/10, when DNA replication/DNA damage together were the better morphological match for uniform enlargement without multipolarity.
- Sampled mid-high doses first (3 uM, 30 uM, 10 uM) which saturated cell_area signal and made the 1 uM mitotic-like spike look like an outlier until e13 replicated it.

Proposed next experiment: EdU pulse plus gamma-H2AX and phospho-H3 flow cytometry across 0.3-10 uM with thymidine rescue to test S-phase inhibition versus DNA breaks and mitotic fraction and confirm thymidylate synthase dependence.
